title: 第17章 入藏经阁寻奇妙法第18章 土风灵根亦有妙处
content_zh:
次日清晨，狐歌手中握着一只蜣螂，手持紫霄令牌，进入了道宗的藏经阁之中。
此阁高耸入云，共计十二层。
据说层数越高，收藏的典籍便越是珍贵玄奥，非立下大功者不得入内。
以狐歌目前的权限，仅能进入前六层。
藏经阁内自成乾坤，空间广阔。
无数灵木书架排列有序，上面摆放着玉简、帛书、骨片等各式载体。
灵光氤氲，道韵流转。
一至二层：面向广大外门弟子及新晋内门弟子。
收藏的是修真界流传较广的基础功法（如《引气诀详解》、《五行基础法术大全》）
低阶丹方器谱、常见妖兽图鉴、基础阵法解析等。
旨在为弟子打下坚实根基。
三至四层：面向资深内门弟子及核心弟子。
收藏的是道宗历代前辈改良、创立的独门功法（如《青元剑诀》、《厚土搬山诀》）。
威力强大的攻击防御法术、精深炼丹炼器手法，已是外界难得一见的真传。
五至六层：面向真传弟子及部分立下功劳的长老。
收藏的则是更为高深玄妙的功法秘术（如《幻波心经》、《九霄雷法》）。
以及大量的前辈修行心得札记、宗门秘史记载、高阶符箓阵法初解。
甚至开始出现一些残破的古籍和未完全破译的古老玉简。
狐歌并未在前几层过多停留，目光扫视一圈后边，径直走到了第六层。
他不寻功法，不学法术，也不看神通。

而是不断的翻看着前辈高人的修行札记、对于天地灵气的感悟、以及对各种偏门法则的探讨之中。
“无趣，都是些垃圾一般的东西！”
狐歌将手中珍贵的元婴修士所留的感悟，如同垃圾一般扔在一旁。
径直走向另一片区域——奇异录。
这片区域并没有任何功法斗技，记载的都是世间的奇异之事：
如异虫，异灵根，天灾，奇物等等。
“茅兄，既然进入了藏经阁之中，不妨你也寻一篇适合你的功法？”
“不需要！”
“那神通呢，此地的神通皆非凡物，不如看上一看？”
“不需要，人族的功法不适合我，我有自己的道，有自己的神通！”
听见茅不易如此说道，狐歌脸上无奈的笑了笑。
随后不再多劝，拿起手中的《异虫录》翻看了起来。
content_en:
Early the next morning, the fox singer held a dung beetle in his hand and the Zixiao Token in his hand, and entered the Dao Sect's Sutra Pavilion.
This pavilion towers into the sky, with a total of twelve floors.
It is said that the higher the level, the more precious and mysterious the collected classics are, and those who have made great achievements are not allowed to enter.
With Hu Ge's current permissions, he can only enter the first six floors.
The Sutra Pavilion is a world of its own, with a vast space.
Countless spiritual wood bookshelves are arranged in an orderly manner, with various carriers such as jade slips, silk books, and bone fragments placed on them.
The spiritual light is dense and the Taoist rhyme is flowing.
The first to second floors: open to the vast number of outer sect disciples and new inner sect disciples.
The collection contains basic exercises that are widely circulated in the world of cultivation (such as "Detailed Explanation of Qi-Entraining Techniques" and "Encyclopedia of Basic Techniques of the Five Elements")
Low-level elixir recipes, illustrations of common monsters and beasts, analysis of basic formations, etc.
Aiming to lay a solid foundation for disciples.
The third to fourth floors: open to senior inner disciples and core disciples.
The collection contains unique techniques improved and created by Daozong's predecessors (such as "Qingyuan Sword Technique" and "Thick Earth Moving Mountain Technique").
The powerful attack and defense spells and the profound alchemy and weapon refining techniques are the true teachings rarely seen in the outside world.
Fifth to sixth floors: For true disciples and some elders who have made meritorious services.
What is collected is the more profound and mysterious skills and secrets (such as "Huanbo Heart Sutra" and "Nine Heavens Thunder Method").
As well as a large number of notes on the practice experience of seniors, records of the secret history of the sect, and preliminary explanations of high-level talisman formations.
Some broken ancient books and incompletely deciphered ancient jade slips even began to appear.
Hu Ge didn't stay too long on the first few floors. He glanced around and went straight to the sixth floor.
He doesn't look for skills, doesn't learn magic, and doesn't look at supernatural powers.
Instead, he kept looking through the practice notes of senior masters, his understanding of the aura of heaven and earth, and his discussion of various deviant laws.
"It's boring, it's all rubbish!"
Hu Ge threw the valuable insights left by the Yuanying monk in his hand aside like garbage.
Go straight to another area - Strange Record.
There are no martial arts or fighting skills in this area, only strange things in the world are recorded:
Such as alien insects, alien spiritual roots, natural disasters, strange objects, etc.
"Brother Mao, since you have entered the Sutra Pavilion, why don't you also find a technique that suits you?"
"No need!"
"What about magical powers? The magical powers here are all extraordinary. Why don't you take a look?"
"No need, the human technique is not suitable for me. I have my own way and my own magical powers!"
Hearing what Mao Buyi said, Hu Ge smiled helplessly on his face.
Then without further persuasion, I picked up the "Insects" in my hand and started reading.
